page.overview:
Who is Erio?

Erio is the information broker of the former Roger Pirates.

Erio is a slim muscular man with light blue shoulder-length wavy hair and a dark-colored mustache. He is tan-skinned, with round eyes and a thin nose. He wears a pink open-buttoned shirt with a green flower pattern on it, a white fedora with a black horizontal stripe in the middle, light-colored pants, and shoes.

Nothing is known about Erio's personality. However, he, like other pirates, loves treasure, jealously guarding the loot from other pirates in the God Valley, but at the same time he put a richly decorated crown on his head.

As the Roger's Pirates info broker, Erio was likely skilled in collecting and exchanging information with whatever other contacts he had while active.
